title: On a small or keyed layer a press lands on what it aims at
goal: Two places on the canvas take a press meant for something else. On a layer about 40 points across the depth arrow covers much of its upper right, so trying to move the layer pushes it in depth instead. And when the playhead sits on a key, the key's ring sits under the layer's middle where the 3D handles are drawn, so the ring cannot be clicked. Both should go to what the pointer is aimed at.
notes: From audit rough lines, not reproduced by the manager: queue/audits/2026-10-13-3d-grippers-on-a-picked-layer.json ('On a layer about 40 points across, the depth arrow covers much of its upper right quarter: a press there pushes it in depth instead of moving it') and queue/audits/2026-10-13-every-key-dot-picks.json ('When the playhead sits on a key, that key's ring is under the layer's middle, where the 3D handles are drawn... the ring cannot be clicked'). Searches 'depth arrow small layer', 'key ring 3D handles': nothing open. Rule: never cover what is being manipulated; hit areas should shrink or step aside on small layers rather than grow over them.
acceptance: Reproduced first: both cases run in a walk at Next defaults before any change, and the log quotes what each press did
On a 40 point layer, a press anywhere on the layer away from the drawn arrow moves the layer; the arrow still pushes in depth when pressed on its own drawing
With the playhead on a key, the key's ring on the canvas can be clicked and picks that key, and the 3D handles still work
The walk passes twice in a row; audit written under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Reproduced at Next defaults before any change (walks /tmp/pz-repro/a.json, before-ring.json, before-small.json, on the code before this fix). SMALL LAYER: rectangle 54 doc pts (40 view pts) at (480,480); a drag from (526,499), 5.7 view pts beside the drawn depth arrow, left the frame at (480,480,54,54) and the Info values read 'Transform Depth -150': the press pushed it in depth instead of moving it. Same at the walk's point (522,582): expectBox FAILED '"Rectangle" sits at (480, 560)', i.e. it did not move. KEY RING: Position keyed at 1s and 3s, playhead on the 3s key: the ring sits on the title's middle UNDER the pivot crosshair (drawn below it, so it reads as part of the crosshair). A click dead on its centre did pick it (expectKeyPick Position 2 passed), but a click on its upper right edge (958,421) 'the keys picked are none': the arrow's 9 pt slack covers half the ring, and the ring always yielded to any 3D handle in reach. Fix: SpaceHandles.hit gains onBody (inside the picked layer's box a 3D handle catches only within 4 pt of its drawing) and markReach (a key ring nearer than the handle keeps the press, nearest-mark rule); rings draw above the crosshair.

Fixed and verified: small-or-keyed-layer-presses-walk passed twice in a row at Next defaults (no flags); Scripts/test.sh green (13310 tests); 11 neighbouring walks green (3d-grippers, every-key-dot-picks, every-handle-lights-on-hover, tilt-and-flip, tilt-keys-like-a-move, rotate-a-tilted-layer-live, transform-bar, transform-values-info/link, camera-settings-on-the-frame, framing-a-zoom-shows-one-box). Looked at every audit picture: 1 shows the ring drawn over the crosshair, 2 the ring picked (blue hover look under the resting pointer), 3 the title swung with Rotation Y and Depth lanes, 4-6 the 54pt rectangle picked, moved to X 540 with no Depth row, then pushed by the arrow. Left rough, not filed: a picked ring under the resting pointer shows the blue hover look until the pointer moves (second time noted, after the 2026-10-13 key dot audit; transient, a person sees white as soon as they move); on the body the arrow's catch is now 4pt on every layer, not just small ones (deliberate: one rule, never cover what is manipulated).

Shipped a0330b28. On a picked layer's own body a 3D handle catches only on its drawing (SpaceHandles.drawnReach 4pt), so on a 40pt layer a press beside the depth arrow moves the layer; a key ring under the 3D handles takes the press when nearer (markReach, nearest-mark rule) and draws above the pivot crosshair. Reproduced first on the old code (Depth -150, ring edge click picked nothing). Verified: new walk small-or-keyed-layer-presses-walk green twice at Next defaults, 11 neighbouring walks green, Scripts/test.sh green. Audit queue/audits/2026-10-16-small-or-keyed-layer-presses.json.
